# External References

Sources someone else wrote that this project cites: papers, specs, vendor documentation, standards, and pinned copies of pages the work depends on.
Anyone reading the code may need the source behind it, so it travels with the repo.

**A file here is never edited.**
It is someone else's text.
When the source publishes a new version, replace the file and update its row, recording where it came from and when it was retrieved, so a reader can tell which version the code was written against.

Large sources are expensive to open, so keep their read cost in the index accurate and their `read_when` specific.

| File | Source | Retrieved |
|---|---|---|
| [`lindon-2022-rapid-regression-detection.md`](lindon-2022-rapid-regression-detection.md) | Lindon, Sanden and Shirikian, KDD 2022; arXiv 2205.14762v2 (a pinned citation; arXiv's license doesn't allow vendoring the PDF) | 2026-11-06 |
